note: Official or vendor-maintained tools an AI may use alongside WatchOver. Nothing is loaded by default; MCP servers are optional everywhere, and every entry names a CLI fallback. Online verification of these entries was not performed in the v0.1a build, so each entry's last_checked is null and its check_status is UNKNOWN until someone checks its source. Each source names the publisher and the official document or repository rather than a web address, so no real domain appears in this repository; look the source up from the publisher.

entries.name: Google Cloud CLI (gcloud)
entries.source: Google Cloud: Install the Google Cloud CLI (official documentation)
entries.install_or_access: Install the Google Cloud SDK, then sign in with gcloud auth login or use an existing configuration.
entries.permissions: The roles of the signed-in account on the target project; read-only roles are enough for recon.

risk.note: Create, update and delete verbs change billable resources; log each as intent and result.

entries.check_note: Online verification not performed in the v0.1a build.
entries.cli_fallback: This is the CLI fallback for GCP.

entries.name: Google Cloud Pricing Calculator
entries.install_or_access: Open in a browser; no account needed.

risk.note: Read-only estimates; record price_checked_at only when actually used.

entries.check_note: Online verification not performed in the v0.1a build.
entries.cli_fallback: gcloud billing and the published price lists; otherwise leave price_checked_at null and state the uncertainty.

entries.name: Cloudflare dashboard (DNS)
entries.install_or_access: The human signs in and edits records by hand (manual-edit mode).
entries.permissions: The human's own account; the AI holds no credential.

risk.note: A public DNS change is an external release and needs an approved decision.

entries.check_note: Online verification not performed in the v0.1a build.
entries.cli_fallback: dig to verify what the human changed.

entries.name: Cloudflare API v4 (DNS records)
entries.source: Cloudflare: API reference, DNS records (official documentation)
entries.install_or_access: curl with an API token scoped to one zone and DNS edit, read from an environment variable (scoped-token mode).
entries.permissions: Zone DNS edit on one zone only.

risk.note: Record changes are public; never log the token, only the variable name.

entries.check_note: Online verification not performed in the v0.1a build.
entries.cli_fallback: curl against the API, or manual-edit mode through the dashboard.

entries.name: Cloudflare MCP servers

risk.note: Broad tokens could change more than DNS; keep write actions behind the decision gate.

entries.check_note: Online verification not performed in the v0.1a build.
entries.cli_fallback: curl against the Cloudflare API, and dig.
